bio_am: Ծնած է Շուշի՝ 1883-ին։ Վանի ամենահեղինակաւոր զինուորական յեղափոխականը, 1915-ի Ապրիլին դաւադրաբար սպաննուեցաւ։
bio_en: Nikol Poghosian, known as Vana Ishkhan, was born in Shushi in 1883 and received his baptism of fire as a young haiduk in the border fighting of 1903-04 in which comrades such as Menak, Torgom, Nevruz and Khan fell. In 1904 he entered Van with Koms and took charge of the battered party's armed forces, forming his famous 'flying band' that terrorised Kurdish brigands and usurers and won the love of the peasants, who sang 'Ishkhan came, Mauser in hand'. Aram Manukian later called him the most authoritative military revolutionary in Van. In April 1915, sent to mediate in Shatakh, he and his companions were treacherously murdered in their sleep; their bodies were given a public funeral in liberated Van in May 1915.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Pictured with Aram, Kosti, Torgom and Menak in #137.
